FileTreeSidebar.note: Ported from PaneFileTree: h-64/w-72 bordered panel with a sticky header and a viewport of ten file rows. Content clips cleanly at the viewport edge, which is the visible evidence the scroll area is doing its job (the thumb is auto-hidden at rest by design).

TranscriptScroll.note: Chat transcript with UserAvatar + text-chat-meta / text-chat message rows; the last message is cut at the fold, showing overflow is scrollable rather than clipped-away layout.

HorizontalLogs.note: allowHorizontal=true with a wide mono build log — lines run past the right edge, confirming the horizontal axis is enabled. Distinct from the two vertical cells.
